content: अनुधाव् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To run after; follow; ऋषीणां पुनराद्यानां वाचमर्थोऽनुधावति <ls>U. 1. 10</ls> the sense follows the words (the words being not uttered with a view to a particular sense); स्वरुचिं निश्चयतोऽनुधावति <ls>Śi. 16. 44</ls> follows his own will. .²2 To run up to, approach. .²3 To cleanse, wash.
